boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Lebanon Valley College
boards.description: Ten under-21 food and treat destinations with official pages documenting service until at least 10 p.m., ranging from Annville pickup to longer Lebanon and Hershey runs.

cards.title: The Close-to-Campus Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Annville pickup open into the early morning
cards.notes: Check the live closing time, order before leaving campus, and use the East Main Street store for a short late pizza run.
cards.short_summary: An Annville carryout option whose official location page documents service as late as 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's identifies its Annville restaurant at 1405 East Main Street and showed it open until 1:00 a.m. when fetched.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1405 East Main Street | Domino's in Annville
cards.access_notes: The official location page showed a 1:00 a.m. closing time when fetched; hours can vary by day, so confirm before departing.

cards.title: The All-Night Lebanon Run
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour restaurant and drive-thru in Lebanon
cards.notes: Use this stop when the clock rules out shorter-hour choices, and verify whether lobby or drive-thru service fits your group.
cards.short_summary: A Lebanon fallback with both restaurant and drive-thru hours listed around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists the 757 E Cumberland Street location's restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru hours as 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Lebanon, PA at 757 E Cumberland St | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 24-hour restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru service Monday through Sunday; confirm holiday exceptions.

cards.title: The 2 A.M. Drive-Thru Run
cards.subtitle: Late drive-thru service on Cumberland Street
cards.notes: Plan this as a vehicle-based stop after the dining room closes; review the official page before leaving for service changes.
cards.short_summary: A Lebanon drive-thru documented until 2 a.m., with earlier dine-in closure.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. every day at 2100 Cumberland Street in Lebanon.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Lebanon, PA — 2100 Cumberland Street
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 2:00 a.m. daily; the page shows dine-in ending earlier, so late visits require a vehicle.

cards.title: The West Cumberland Frosty Run
cards.subtitle: Restaurant and drive-thru service until 1 a.m.
cards.notes: Head to the west-side Lebanon location when you need seating or drive-thru flexibility, then confirm holiday-hour notices.
cards.short_summary: A west Lebanon location listing both its restaurant and drive-thru through 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 10:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. daily at 2420 W. Cumberland Street.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 2420 W. Cumberland St in Lebanon, PA
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 1:00 a.m. every day; the official page notes that holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: The East Lebanon Late Run
cards.subtitle: A second 1 a.m. option across Lebanon
cards.notes: Choose this East Lehman Street location when your route approaches Lebanon from the east, and check the page before travel.
cards.short_summary: An east Lebanon counterpart with documented restaurant and drive-thru service until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. daily at 1490 East Lehman Street.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 1490 East Lehman Street in Lebanon, PA
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 1:00 a.m. seven days a week; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: The Midnight Pizza Hut Run
cards.subtitle: Lebanon carryout and delivery listed until midnight
cards.notes: Check delivery coverage before counting on a campus drop-off; otherwise use the East Cumberland Street location for carryout.
cards.short_summary: A Lebanon pizza option whose official listing documents service through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut's official Lebanon page identifies the restaurant at 732 E Cumberland Street and lists it open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Pizza Delivery & Carryout in Lebanon, PA | Pizza Hut
cards.access_notes: The official Lebanon listing showed the location open until midnight; confirm the day's carryout and delivery cutoff before ordering.

cards.title: The Downtown Lebanon Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: A second late Domino's route farther into Lebanon
cards.notes: Compare its live closing time with the Annville store, then select this location only when the Lebanon route makes more sense.
cards.short_summary: A distinct Cumberland Street pizza stop with official late-night pickup and delivery information.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's identifies its Lebanon restaurant at 503 Cumberland Street and showed a midnight closing time when fetched.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 503 Cumberland Street | Domino's in Lebanon
cards.access_notes: The page showed service until midnight when fetched and states that store hours vary; verify the live cutoff before ordering.

cards.title: The Late Hershey Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Pizza and sandwiches served after the full menu ends
cards.notes: Make this a planned Hershey trip, arrive before the 11:30 p.m. late-menu cutoff, and note the posted accessibility limitation.
cards.short_summary: A longer sit-down run where the official schedule keeps pizza and sandwiches available late.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenicci's lists service until midnight Tuesday–Sunday, with pizzas and sandwiches available until 11:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Fenicci's of Hershey Italian Restaurant Since 1935
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Tuesday–Sunday; the full menu ends at 10:00 p.m., while pizzas and sandwiches continue until 11:30 p.m. The site says the building is not ADA accessible.

cards.title: The Friday-Night Hershey Dinner Run
cards.subtitle: Downtown Hershey dining until 11 p.m. on weekends
cards.notes: Reserve this longer run for Friday or Saturday, check the kitchen schedule, and use the restaurant setting rather than bar service.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Hershey dining room with later Friday and Saturday closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Hershey Social lists hours of 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday at 27 W Chocolate Avenue.
cards.source_title: Hershey Social Restaurant + Bar Is Now Open
cards.access_notes: The restaurant is listed until 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday and 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; confirm food-service timing before the drive.

cards.title: The Late Chocolate Run
cards.subtitle: Seasonal evening treats at Chocolate World
cards.notes: Check the dated calendar before driving; summer closing times vary, and individual attractions or food counters may close earlier.
cards.short_summary: A family-oriented Hershey treat destination whose official calendar reaches 11 p.m. on selected dates.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Chocolate World calendar lists selected July and August 2026 dates with operating hours until 11:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation | HERSHEY'S CHOCOLATE WORLD
cards.access_notes: Selected summer dates are listed until 11:00 p.m.; hours vary by date, and food counters or paid experiences may follow separate schedules.
